# Moru Core v26.45.0

This release expands the optional Rust runtime and publishes native bundles for
macOS ARM64 and Linux x86_64. Native coverage now includes prepared registry and
completion reads, additional status/continuation paths, manifest checks, offline
Figma validation and per-session transcript overhead aggregation. These paths
retain source and environment guards plus Python compatibility for unsupported
inputs; the full Python-to-Rust migration remains in progress.

## Download and install

Download the archive matching your host, together with SHA256SUMS and BUILD.json.
The two native archives are moru-native-macos-arm64.tar.gz and
moru-native-linux-x86_64.tar.gz. New macOS Intel and Linux ARM64 archives are no
longer produced; older releases retain their original assets. Windows native
execution is not supported.

Use Core source at v26.45.0. Preserve local edits when selecting that revision.
For a new checkout only:

```sh
git clone --branch v26.45.0 https://github.com/taehwandev/moru-core.git ~/.moru/core
cd ~/.moru/core
python3 scripts/native-runtime-bundle.py install --bundle /path/to/moru-native-macos-arm64.tar.gz
python3 scripts/setup-agent-hooks.py --dry-run
python3 scripts/setup-agent-hooks.py
python3 scripts/setup-agent-hooks.py --check
```

Choose the Linux archive on Linux. Python 3.9+ and Git remain required; receiving
computers do not need Rust or Cargo. Source-mismatched archives are rejected.
Release downloads do not have the temporary Actions artifact expiry.

## Verification and recovery

Release promotion requires both host jobs to pass the pinned Rust/locked-crate
checks, runtime conformance suite and transported-consumer smoke checks at the
tagged source revision. BUILD.json records exact build/run provenance and archive
hashes; SHA256SUMS covers both native archives.

Full hosted builds run only on explicit manual requests. Routine source pushes
do not create new bundles or public releases. No state schema migration or
credential change is required. Existing renderer chains and Spill connections
are preserved. Set MORU_LAUNCHER_BACKEND=python and
MORU_CHECKOUT_IDENTITY_BACKEND=python for explicit native rollback, or select the
previous release with its matching source and archive while preserving edits.

macOS targets version 13+; Linux is built/tested on Ubuntu 24.04. Older glibc is
not established compatible. No new cross-host speedup claim is made.

Full source comparison: https://github.com/taehwandev/moru-core/compare/v26.44.1...v26.45.0
